title: 2026 Guideline for Adult Stroke Rehabilitation and Recovery: A Guideline From the American Heart Association and American Stroke Association

recommendations.text: AHA/ASA published this guideline online on 27 August 2026 (PMID 42657476; DOI 10.1161/STR.0000000000000536), replacing the 2016 guideline. The official AHA hub links an AHA/ASA collaborative guide with graded summaries; that supporting guide was accessible in the 30 September review. The complete published article, supportive text and any correction reconciliation remain unavailable. This library record contains no extracted recommendations; use the linked guide with its population and grading context, and consult the original article when available.
